Name: Simon of Cyrene
Summary: Simon of Cyrene was a passer-by coming in from the country whom the soldiers compelled to carry Jesus' cross to Golgotha. Mark names his sons Alexander and Rufus, suggesting his family later joined the church.
KeyStory: Simon did not volunteer; he was pressed into service, and carried the cross behind Jesus to the place of the skull.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Alexander, Son of Simon of Cyrene; Rufus, Son of Simon of Cyrene
LifeLesson: Sometimes the cross finds us on an ordinary errand. Simon's forced steps became his family's doorway into faith.
